name: Live Bento Grid
description: A hairline bento grid for an analytics product: six live tiles in black and white, from a self-drawing chart to a dot-map, staggering in with counting figures.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black surfaces with white ink, or warm paper with near-black ink. The stat tile always inverts; the map tile sinks to the darkest surface.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one signal colour: the chart’s “now” dot, the heatmap peak, live cities and the answer’s latest bar.

props.name: ambient
props.description: Ambient motion: the metric cycle, typing, switch flips, heatmap ticks and live cities. Off leaves a still grid; entrances and clicks still work.

props.name: heading
props.description: Optional section header. Omit it (the default) and the grid stands on its own.

props.name: headingMuted
props.description: Second clause of the heading at 40% ink.

props.name: trend
props.description: Line-chart tile. The line draws in, then morphs between metrics every 4.2s until someone picks one; each new total counts up.

props.name: stat
props.description: Inverted tile: one number that counts up out of a blur, then two meters that fill.

props.name: heatmap
props.description: Weekday × hour heatmap; cells fill in a diagonal wave, then keep ticking while on screen.

props.name: search
props.description: Search tile that types each question and then shows its answer.

props.name: alerts
props.description: Settings card of real switches that flip themselves until touched; the preview message follows the watched switch.

props.name: map
props.description: Deep tile: a dot-matrix world that sweeps in west to east, pulsing cities, a live total and the top four cities.

props.name: children
props.description: Compose your own grid from the exported tiles (TrendTile, StatTile, HeatmapTile, SearchTile, AlertsTile, MapTile) instead of the default six.
